name: comp-259
title: Slider With Buttons
description: A numeric setting with small outlined buttons at both ends of a slider. Buttons step the value up or down by five, the track can also be dragged, and the count above updates.
use: A figure should move in predictable small steps, with dragging for a bigger jump.
avoid: Step size and range are fixed at five over 0 to 200, so another scale means a source edit.
a11y: Buttons are well named, but the slider's accessible name wrongly calls it a dual range slider. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A line of figures sits at the top left. Below, a small rounded square with a minus sign, a long grey track with a white filled length and a round knob, and a matching square with a plus sign.
behaves: Each press of plus or minus moves the value by five and repaints the filled track, while dragging the knob sets it directly. The buttons grey out when the value reaches the bottom or top of the range.
customise: Minimum, maximum, step and starting value sit in the source, and the label text is built from the value. Button icons and sizes need edits.
weight: light: Two small buttons and one slider; no animation runs between presses.
